item.title: Troy Melton’s push for Opening Day roster spot now on pause
item.description: Troy Melton entered camp intent on making things difficult for Detroit Tigers decision-makers. “Their job is to put the best 26 guys on the field,” Melton said earlier this spring in Lakeland. “It’s my job to make sure I’m one of those 26. So that’s all I’m going to try to do: get people out, make pitches and make the decision hard.”

item.title: Trump’s ‘America First’ campaign battle cry gives way to military strikes abroad
item.description: Trump’s decision to strike Iran pulls him toward the kind of conflict he once attacked.

item.title: Olivia Olson’s 28 points help power No. 8 Michigan to an 87-69 win over No. 14 Maryland
item.description: Olivia Olson scored 21 of her game-high 28 points in the first half, and No. 8 Michigan snapped No. 14 Maryland’s six-game winning streak with an 87-69 victory in the teams’ regular-season finale on Saturday.

item.title: Photo gallery of the 2026 D1 cheer regional hosted at Troy Athens High School
item.description: Photos of the action from the D1 cheerleading regional held at Troy Athens on Saturday, Feb. 28, 2026.

item.title: CHEER REGIONAL ROUNDUP: Falcons first out of Rochester schools at Troy Athens
item.description: Rochester will hope its performance at Saturday's D1 regional is a sign of things to come.

item.title: No. 3 Michigan backup guard L.J. Cason to miss remainder of season with torn right knee ligament
item.description: No. 3 Michigan sophomore guard L.J. Cason will miss the remainder of the season with a torn ACL in his right knee, the team announced Saturday.

item.title: Red Wings lose for fifth time in seven games, falling 5-2 to hot Hurricanes
item.description: Shayne Gostisbehere had a goal and two assists to lead the Carolina Hurricanes to their fifth straight win, 5-2 over the Detroit Red Wings on Saturday night.

item.title: Girls basketball postseason preview: A district-by-district look at the 2026 contenders
item.description: Who’s next? New blood? Is someone else ready to get over the hump? Or will a familiar logo go up on the scoreboard at Breslin Center? All of those answers are dependent on what happens this week in districts, which tip off Monday. Here’s a district-by-district outlook for Oakland County’s teams:

item.title: Photos of No. 2 Detroit Catholic Central and No. 1 Howell in a D1 hockey quarterfinal
item.description: In a matchup worthy of being held a stage or two later, No. 2 Detroit Catholic Central defeated top-ranked Howell 1-0 Saturday, Feb. 28, 2026 to advance to the D1 semifinals at USA Hockey Arena.

item.title: Nick McQuaid sends No. 2 Catholic Central to semifinals with game-winner against top-ranked Howell
item.description: The Detroit Catholic Central Shamrocks earned another trip to the state semifinals at USA Hockey Arena next weekend, squeaking by the Howell Highlanders 1-0 on Saturday afternoon.
